messages.cli.territory.add.option.branch: Default branch, where quest branches start (default: origin's HEAD, then the branch checked out).
messages.cli.territory.add.option.id: Territory id (default: the folder name, lowercase, joined by hyphens).
messages.cli.territory.add.option.kind: Territory kind: code, docs, content, data or mixed (default code).
messages.cli.territory.add.option.name: Display name, up to 24 characters (default: the folder name).
messages.cli.territory.add.summary: Attach a repo or folder to the kingdom (open a realm).
messages.cli.territory.bad_id: Territory id «{id}» is not valid: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, up to 32 characters, not global; set one with --id.
messages.cli.territory.git_missing: The folder has .git but git was not found on PATH.
messages.cli.territory.id_taken: Territory {id} already exists; choose another id with --id.
messages.cli.territory.inside_repo: Note: the folder is inside the git repo {root}; quest branches will start from that repo.
messages.cli.territory.no_branch: Cannot tell the default branch (detached HEAD, no origin); add --branch <branch>.
messages.cli.territory.none: No territories yet. Add one with: elvaria territory add <folder>
messages.cli.territory.rules_hint: Hint: the repo has {count} files under .claude/rules that Claude Code cannot write; add "{glob}" to laws.patch_paths in territories/{id}/territory.json so characters can change them as a patch.
messages.cli.territory.claude_local: Warning: the repo has a CLAUDE.local.md, and Claude Code loads it into every plot under {dir} (it sits in a parent folder), so characters read your personal notes. Move it out of the repo before quests run there.
messages.cli.territory.graph.summary: Build the code graph of a territory at a commit (0 mana) and ask it a question.
messages.cli.territory.graph.option.commit: Commit, branch or tag to build at (default: the tip of the default branch).
messages.cli.territory.graph.option.query: Words to ask the graph (code names and paths work best), as graphify query does.
messages.cli.territory.graph.built: Built the code graph of {territory} at {commit}: {nodes} nodes, {edges} edges, {seconds} s, in {dir}.
messages.cli.territory.graph.reused: The code graph of {territory} at {commit} is built already, in {dir}.
messages.cli.territory.graph.unknown: There is no territory {id}; see elvaria territory list.
messages.cli.territory.graph.no_git: Territory {id} has no git: a code graph is built at a commit.
messages.cli.territory.graph.no_graphify: No graphify is pinned (or git is missing): install graphify and run elvaria doctor --pin.
messages.cli.territory.graph.no_commit: git does not know {ref} in this territory.
messages.cli.territory.delivery.summary: Show how a territory delivers a done quest's branch (manual, pr, pr_merge), or change it.
messages.cli.territory.delegation.summary: Shows the delegation of the seal on a territory (the kingdom's scope of it, whether the territory merges by itself, whether the breaker suspended it, since which quest and why), or resumes it. 0 mana.
messages.cli.territory.delegation.option.resume: Resume the delegation the breaker suspended (inbox command resume_delegation): new quests there may go without the seal again.
messages.cli.territory.delegation.off: The kingdom delegates no seal (kingdom.json has no delegation.seal): every quest takes its kind's seal_default.
messages.cli.territory.delegation.scope: The kingdom's delegation of the seal: kinds {kinds}, rank up to {max_rank}, at most {max_diff_lines} lines changed.
messages.cli.territory.delegation.pr_merge: Territory {id} merges by itself (delivery mode pr_merge): the delegation covers it.
messages.cli.territory.delegation.not_pr_merge: Territory {id} delivers by {mode}, not pr_merge: the delegation does not cover it, every quest there waits for the seal.
messages.cli.territory.delegation.working: The delegation is not suspended on {id}.
messages.cli.territory.delegation.before_resume: Before resuming, read: elvaria quest show {quest} (its pull request and merge commit), the red check's log in elvaria digest, and whether the fix is merged or on its way. Then: elvaria territory delegation {id} --resume
messages.cli.territory.delegation.not_suspended: The delegation of the seal is not suspended on {id}: nothing to resume.
messages.cli.territory.delegation.resume_sent: Sent: the Steward resumes the delegation of the seal on {id} at its next tick; new quests there may go without the seal again.
messages.cli.territory.delivery.option.mode: manual (the owner merges by hand), pr (the Steward pushes and opens a pull request) or pr_merge (then merges a sealed quest).
messages.cli.territory.delivery.option.merge_meth: merge (a merge commit, the default) or squash.
messages.cli.territory.delivery.option.required_c: A check run or status context pr_merge waits for; repeat it for several; replaces the list.
messages.cli.territory.delivery.option.timeout: Minutes pr_merge waits for the required checks (default 60).
messages.cli.territory.delivery.unset: (territory.json names no delivery: manual, the branch waits for the owner to merge it)
messages.cli.territory.delivery.no_repo: the remote names no repo there
messages.cli.territory.delivery.no_checks: none (merge as soon as the forge says it can)
messages.cli.territory.delivery.saved: Saved in territory.json; the Steward reads it at its next tick.
messages.cli.territory.delivery.doctor_hint: Check the credential and the right to push with: elvaria doctor
messages.cli.territory.patrol.summary: Shows whether the daily patrol watches a territory's default branch (its checks, 0 mana), or turns it on or off.
messages.cli.territory.patrol.option.on: Turn the patrol on (writes territory.patrol, keeping what it has).
messages.cli.territory.patrol.option.off: Turn the patrol off (removes territory.patrol, its scans and follow_up too).
messages.cli.territory.patrol.option.now: Ask the Steward to patrol the territory now (inbox command patrol): after fixing a red default branch by hand, or for a flaky check; green, the territory takes work again at the next tick.
messages.cli.territory.patrol.now_alone: --now does not go with --on or --off: turn the patrol on first, then run again with --now.
messages.cli.territory.patrol.now_off: The patrol does not watch territory {id} (not on, or no git): nothing to run now. Turn it on: elvaria territory patrol {id} --on
messages.cli.territory.patrol.now_sent: Sent: the Steward patrols the default branch of {id} now, outside the tick; the digest says what it found (elvaria digest).
messages.cli.territory.patrol.no_git: The territory has no git: the patrol passes it by.
messages.cli.territory.patrol.follow_up: A check that turns red opens a draft quest: kind {kind}, rank {rank}, class {class}.
messages.cli.territory.patrol.no_follow_up: A check that turns red is a digest item only (no follow_up).
messages.cli.territory.patrol.schedule_off: The kingdom's patrol is off: set schedule.patrol.enabled to true in kingdom.json.
messages.cli.territory.patrol.edit_hint: Edit scans and follow_up in territory.json (see docs/guides/operating-a-kingdom.md).
messages.cli.territory.patrol.saved: Written to territory.json; the next patrol reads it.
messages.cli.territory.enqueue.summary: Puts a pull request of your own session into a pr_merge territory's merge queue (a guest entry): the Steward tries it merged into the default branch after the quests due now, and merges it when green (0 mana).
messages.cli.territory.enqueue.option.pr: The pull request number on the forge; its branch and head are the forge's when its turn comes.
messages.cli.territory.enqueue.bad_pr: --pr takes a pull request number from 1, not {value}.
messages.cli.territory.enqueue.unknown: There is no territory {id}; see elvaria territory list.
messages.cli.territory.enqueue.not_pr_merge: Territory {id} delivers by {mode}, not pr_merge: the Steward merges nothing there. Merge the pull request yourself, or: elvaria territory delivery {id} --mode pr_merge
messages.cli.territory.enqueue.sent: Sent: pull request #{pr} waits in the merge queue of {id}. The Steward never writes to its branch; refused (delivery.guest_refused: conflict, red checks), merge the default branch into it or fix it, push, and enqueue it again.
messages.cli.territory.deliver.summary: Send a deferred territory's delivery train off now, without waiting for it to fill or for its first quest's wait (deliver command, 0 mana).
messages.cli.territory.deliver.unknown: There is no territory {id}; see elvaria territory list.
messages.cli.territory.deliver.not_deferred: Territory {id} is checked {mode}, not deferred: it has no delivery train, each quest goes alone. See elvaria territory checks {id}.
messages.cli.territory.deliver.sent: Sent: the delivery train of {id} leaves at the next tick with the quests on its platform, or with the first that boards it. A quest whose delivery failed boards again by elvaria quest deliver <quest>.
messages.cli.territory.delivery.unknown: There is no territory {id}; see elvaria territory list.
messages.cli.territory.delivery.no_remote: Territory {id} has no git remote (origin), which {mode} pushes to: nothing changed.
messages.cli.territory.delivery.not_forge: The remote of territory {id}, {remote}, names no repo on {forge}: nothing changed.
messages.cli.territory.check.summary: Scores a territory: tries commands.setup and every check on a clean plot at the head of its default branch, then prints its scorecard (0 mana).
messages.cli.territory.check.unknown: No territory {id}; see elvaria territory list.
messages.cli.territory.check.trying: Trying territory {id}: a clean plot at the head of {branch}, commands.setup then every check, as the Steward runs them (this may take minutes)…
messages.cli.territory.check.stopped: Trial stopped; its plot is gone and no result was kept.
messages.cli.territory.check.leftover: The trial's folder stays: {detail}. Close the program holding it; the next trial removes it first.
messages.cli.territory.check.title: Scorecard of territory {id}, tried on {branch} ({base}):
messages.cli.territory.check.ready: Ready: the trial passes; {count} other items do not, see docs/guides/operating-a-kingdom.md §3 for the fixes.
messages.cli.territory.check.not_ready: Not ready: the trial fails. Fix it, then run elvaria territory check {id} again.
messages.cli.territory.check.untried: Territory {id} has no git, so nothing was tried; the other items stand as above.
messages.cli.territory.check.item.trial: Trial: setup and every check on a clean plot of the default branch
messages.cli.territory.check.item.set_aside: Runs of checks set aside for their environment
messages.cli.territory.check.reason.no_git: The territory has no git: there is no default branch to try.
messages.cli.territory.check.reason.plot_failed: No plot could be made for the trial: {detail}
messages.cli.territory.check.reason.setup_failed: commands.setup failed: {command} (exit code {exit}). First error line: {line} Log: {log}
messages.cli.territory.check.reason.setup_environ: commands.setup failed because of its environment: {command}. Line: {line} Log: {log}
messages.cli.territory.check.reason.no_checks: The territory has no checks: only the judge reads the work of its quests.
messages.cli.territory.check.reason.check_failed: Check {check} fails on the default branch: {command} (exit code {exit}). First error line: {line} Log: {log}
messages.cli.territory.check.reason.check_timed_o: Check {check} timed out on the default branch: {command}. Log: {log}
messages.cli.territory.check.reason.check_environ: Check {check} failed because of its environment: {command}. Line: {line} Log: {log}
messages.cli.territory.check.reason.check_slow: {check}: {seconds} s, over {max} % of its {minutes} min timeout: on a busy machine it is cut. Raise timeout_minutes or make the check faster.
messages.cli.territory.check.reason.few_check_run: The territory has {runs} runs of checks so far, {min} at least to measure.
messages.cli.territory.check.reason.set_aside_rat: {set_aside}/{runs} runs of checks set aside for their environment ({rate} %, at most {max} %).
messages.cli.territory.check.reason.gazetteer_mis: No gazetteer (territories/<id>/gazetteer.md), or it is empty.
messages.cli.territory.check.reason.gazetteer_uns: The gazetteer has no <!-- elvaria:commit <sha> --> stamp on its first line: nobody knows whether it is fresh.
messages.cli.territory.check.reason.gazetteer_sta: The gazetteer was written at {stamp}; the commits since were not counted.
git does not know the commit {stamp} of the gazetteer's stamp.
The gazetteer was written at {stamp}, {commits} commits ago (at most {max}): read it again, fix it, and stamp the new commit.
messages.cli.territory.check.reason.gazetteer_fre: The gazetteer was written at {stamp}, {commits} commits ago.
messages.cli.territory.check.reason.gazetteer_nam: The gazetteer names all {count} of the territory's commands.
messages.cli.territory.check.reason.shared_paths_: shared_paths not declared; with no hot files, declare an empty list.
messages.cli.territory.check.reason.protected_pat: laws.protected_paths not declared; with nothing to guard, declare an empty list.
messages.cli.territory.check.reason.few_decided: The territory has {decided} quests whose first run was decided, {min} at least to measure.
messages.cli.territory.check.reason.first_pass_ra: {passed}/{decided} quests passed their first run ({rate} %, at least {min} %).
messages.cli.territory.checks.summary: Show how much of its checks a territory's quests run (check_policy: full, narrow or deferred), or change the mode. 0 mana.
messages.cli.territory.checks.option.mode: full (every check `when` selects runs its run, as before), narrow (each runs its narrow command on the quest's diff; the base branch's patrol is the full run) or deferred (narrow, the heavy checks left to a delivery train; needs pr_merge with merge commits).
messages.cli.territory.checks.unknown: There is no territory {id}; see elvaria territory list.
messages.cli.territory.checks.unset: (territory.json names no check_policy: full, the checks as before)
messages.cli.territory.checks.full_when: full run when a quest touches: {globs}
messages.cli.territory.checks.none: none (only a path no check watches)
messages.cli.territory.checks.train: train: departs at {quests} quests or after {minutes} min
messages.cli.territory.checks.no_narrow: No check declares narrow: in this mode every check still runs its run. Add checks[].narrow in territory.json (see docs/guides/operating-a-kingdom.md).
messages.cli.territory.checks.no_train: Mode deferred needs territory {id} to deliver by pr_merge with merge_method merge: nothing changed. See elvaria territory delivery {id}.
messages.cli.territory.checks.saved: Saved in territory.json; the Steward reads it at its next tick.
